//: Replace __TENANT_ID__ with your Microsoft Entra tenant GUID before deploying.
Using a tenant-specific issuer (rather than /common) is what restricts
sign-in to your organisation only. With the built-in Microsoft provider,
ANY Microsoft account - including personal ones - could authenticate.

routes.//: Must precede the /* catch-all. Without it the catch-all also matches the AAD callback, so the callback itself returns 401, the 401 override bounces back to /.auth/login/aad, and sign-in loops forever.

//: 403 deliberately has no rewrite. Rewriting to /index.html would send an
authenticated-but-unassigned user to a page that itself requires a role,
producing a second redirect loop. The default 403 page is correct here.
